source.name: Potion-authored function-calling + continuation (36 items): att-01..24 single-turn — 12 tool pairs where one tool is the obvious neighbour of the right one, every item expects ONE call with a deterministic argument subset; att-25..36 MULTI-TURN (added 1.1.0, 2026-09-01, after the or-gemini-flash empty-stop incident) — the transcript already holds a tool call and its result, and the model must CONTINUE: 6 chain items expect the next tool call (tool-call), 6 conclude items expect a grounded JSON answer from the result (field-contains); an empty stop after a tool result scores 0. Dates resolve against a fixed 'today'
